The '''kinetic-blast rifle''',<ref name="Head-to-Head Tag Teams">''[[Star Wars: Head-to-Head Tag Teams]]''</ref> also known as '''Mustafarian Blaster Rifle''',<ref name="BftG">''[[Star Wars: Battles for the Galaxy]]''</ref> or '''Mustafar rifle''',<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> was a type of long [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]<ref name="Mustafar Sentry" /> that fired bolts of kinetic energy. They were developed by the [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Homeworld/Legends|natives]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] whose skin and [[exoskeleton]]s could withstand the heat radiated by most common [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="NTEGtAS" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The kinetic-blast rifle first appeared without identification in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />
